---
title: "Country profiles"
subtitle: "A one-page summary of policy and implementation status for every *P. vivax* endemic country in the repository."
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(htmltools)
  library(stringr)
})

source("R/explore_helpers.R")

char <- load_characteristic_data() |>
  arrange(Region, Country)
```

::: {.lede}
Browse by region. Each country card links to a fuller profile with the latest first-line treatment, G6PD testing status, programme phase, and contact information where available.
:::

```{r}
#| label: country-grids
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

slugify <- function(s) {
  s <- tolower(str_trim(s))
  s <- str_replace_all(s, "[^a-z0-9]+", "-")
  str_replace_all(s, "(^-|-$)", "")
}

region_card <- function(name, phase, tx) {
  meta_bits <- c()
  if (nzchar(phase)) meta_bits <- c(meta_bits, phase)
  if (nzchar(tx)) meta_bits <- c(meta_bits, paste0("1st-line: ", tx))
  meta <- if (length(meta_bits)) paste(meta_bits, collapse = " · ") else "No detailed policy on file yet"

  tags$a(
    class = "country-card",
    href = paste0("profiles/", slugify(name), ".html"),
    tags$span(class = "name", name),
    tags$span(class = "meta", meta)
  )
}

regions <- c("Asia-Pacific", "Central and South America", "Africa")

grids <- lapply(regions, function(region) {
  sub <- char |> filter(Region == region)
  if (!nrow(sub)) return(NULL)

  cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(sub)), function(i) {
    row <- sub[i, ]
    region_card(
      row$Country,
      str_trim(row$`Program Phase`),
      str_trim(row$`Pv 1st line treatment`)
    )
  })

  tagList(
    tags$h2(region),
    tags$div(class = "country-grid", !!!cards)
  )
})

cat(as.character(tagList(!!!grids)))
```

::: {.callout-edit}
Country profile pages are generated automatically from the live Google Sheet at each rebuild. If a country is missing or out of date, please [submit an update](contribute.qmd).
:::
